name: comparison-header-a-later-builds-header-is-still-a-header
description: The complement, and the case that keeps a shared journal from bricking an older build. A header from a later grammar — kindless, bearing the type marker, carrying fields this build does not know — is recognized as the header it is. Nothing is skipped, the read is complete, and the comparison answers in full. Requiring the type marker AND the absence of a kind would leave a later header unrecognized, its entries headerless, and the file weakened over ordinary version skew.
